title: incident-bot: surface on-call playbook links in incident summaries + auto-runbook trigger
author: Asha Patel
description: Add links to canonical on-call playbooks into incident summaries and introduce an optional auto-runbook trigger that will suggest a runbook when matching SLO symptoms are detected. Motivation: responders frequently ask for the runbook during paging; surfacing curated playbooks reduces mean time to acknowledgement and provides immediate remediation steps. This change implements a playbook mapping config, surfaces matching playbook links in the incident summary payload, and adds a lightweight auto-trigger endpoint that can be opted into per-service. Checklist: - map canonical playbooks via configs/playbook-mapping.yaml - add renderer in pkg/summaries to include playbook links - implement runbook trigger handler in pkg/handlers with rate limiting - add unit + integration tests and docs under docs/oncall - confirm CI and e2e. This PR is focused and backward compatible: if no mapping exists we do not change existing payloads. Related Linear: ENG-2741. See docs link: /docs/oncall/playbooks.md
commits: feat: renderer for playbook links in incident summary payload (pkg/summaries)
feat: runbook trigger endpoint and handler with rate limiting (pkg/handlers/runbook_trigger.go)
chore: add playbook mapping config + sample mappings (configs/playbook-mapping.yaml)
test: unit and integration tests for summary renderer and trigger
fix: nil-safe handling when playbook missing in mapping

release_notes: Incident summaries can now surface on-call playbook links when a mapping exists. Added optional auto-runbook trigger endpoint (opt-in). No breaking changes. See docs/oncall/playbooks.md for configuration and rollout guidance.
